confidence_notes: Overall low. Food and drink anchors blend Numbeo's Jamaica national averages (user-submitted, labelled Nov 2026) with lower Ocho Rios guide figures seen only in search summaries, one dated July 2023, and the sources disagree. Beer uses Numbeo's 0.5 L domestic draught as the standard serving, with a tourist-venue allowance. Cocktail rests on a few reported Ocho Rios prices, cross-checked at about 3.3x beer. Wine_glass is set at about 3x beer because direct restaurant glass prices were weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search was run and no listings or booking pages were checked. FX is the 2026-11-18 RBA observation from search output; a 2026-11-19 print may exist.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Regional basis: Jamaica's Caribbean location, mapped to Latin America because the UN M49 scheme groups the Caribbean within Latin America and the Caribbean. Food and drink anchors use Jamaica's national price averages as the regional basis rather than a foreign comparable city.
